findings.fix: Remove the size attribute or increase it to 10 or more to accommodate all valid postal code formats.
findings.violation: Postal codes vary widely in length; US ZIP codes are 5 - 9 digits and Canadian postal codes are 6 characters. A size of 3 is too restrictive.

findings.fix: Add name="shipspeed" to the select element.
findings.violation: The select element is missing a name attribute, so the selected shipping speed will not be submitted with the form.

findings.fix: Add value attributes to each option, e.g., <option value="standard">Standard</option>.
findings.violation: Option elements lack value attributes, so the display text (e.g., "Standard") will be submitted instead of a standardized code.

findings.fix: Remove the inline style and define the font size via a CSS class.
findings.violation: Inline style mixes presentation into HTML markup instead of using a stylesheet.

findings.fix: Move the layout styles to a CSS class and change the input type to "time" or add a placeholder to clarify the expected format (e.g., "9:00 AM").
findings.violation: Layout is done with inline styles, and the text input provides no indication of the expected time format.

findings.fix: Either remove the button if it is unused, or add a handler and move the styles to a CSS class.
findings.violation: The button is type="button" with no onclick handler or visible purpose, and it contains inline styles. The button appears incomplete or forgotten.

findings.fix: Add name="bday-day" to the select element.
findings.violation: The select element is missing a name attribute, so the selected day will not be submitted with the form.

findings.fix: Add name="bday-month" to the select, and add value attributes like <option value="01">January</option> for each month.
findings.violation: The select is missing a name attribute and the options lack value attributes. Month names will be submitted instead of numeric values.

findings.fix: Add name="bday-year" to the select element.
findings.violation: The select element is missing a name attribute, so the selected year will not be submitted with the form.
The input type is "text" instead of "url", so the browser will not validate the URL format.

findings.evidence: <input id="member-input" name="membership_number" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Must be 8 digits" required="">
findings.fix: Add pattern="[0-9]{8}" to enforce exactly 8 numeric digits.
findings.violation: The placeholder states "Must be 8 digits" but there is no pattern attribute to enforce this validation.

findings.fix: Add a pattern attribute such as pattern="[0-9]+" or provide specific format requirements.
findings.violation: The input is marked as numeric but has no pattern attribute to validate the format or length.

findings.evidence: row-name label "Full name" with name="full_name" and row-legalname label "Your name" with name="legal_name"
findings.fix: Remove one of the duplicate name fields, or if both are needed, clarify their purposes (e.g., rename one to "Legal Name for Documentation").
findings.violation: Two separate fields both ask for a person's name but with different labels ("Full name" vs. "Your name"), creating confusion about whether they are the same or different information.
